the availability of a multi-unit system with deterioration in standby and in storage.
the development of a methodology for the analysis of a repairable multi-component system in which the failure of one unit may lead to a standby failure of the other unit.

the availability of a repairable multi-unit system with standby failure and deterioration in storage, where the units are subjected to failure due to deterioration in storage and the standby unit is also subjected to failure.

the availability of a standby system with deterioration in standby units is always greater than the availability of a similar system without deterioration in standby units.

the present work is an attempt to obtain the generalised measures for multi-component repairable systems with standby failure and deterioration in storage.

we have obtained a generalized availability measure which can be used to evaluate the availability of any system with standby failure and deterioration in storage under the assumption of exponential distribution for the failure time and the repair time.
we are able to derive the measures for the generalised case of n-unit standby redundant system.

the generalised measures are not only useful in reliability and maintainability analysis but also useful for system design.
